entries.name: Abyssal
entries.effect: A small piece of the Abyss, taken or somehow escaped; plainly visible to ***Abyssal Sight***, and incorporeal entities like Ghosts can physically interact with it.

entries.name: Addictive
entries.effect: Breeds craving in those who partake; going without it can cause lots of problems.

entries.name: Analog
entries.effect: Old-school tech; can't be hacked, traced, or wiped remotely.

entries.name: Anointed
entries.effect: Treated with blood, oil, or ritual substance for a single specific use.

entries.name: Antique
entries.effect: Old and rare; valuable to the right buyer or collector.

entries.name: Balanced
entries.effect: Perfectly weighted; you always roll flat with it, ignoring both Advantage and Disadvantage.

entries.name: Blessed
entries.effect: Sanctified by genuine faith; soothing to mortals, uncomfortable for the damned.

entries.name: Boiling
entries.effect: Scalding hot; burns and blisters living flesh on contact without ever setting anything alight.

entries.name: Bound
entries.effect: Tied (magically or biomechanically) to one owner; resists use by anyone else until the bond is broken.

entries.name: Bulky
entries.effect: Big and awkward; hard to hide and gets in the way.

entries.name: Classified
entries.effect: Restricted information; possessing it is dangerous and someone wants it back.

entries.name: Compact
entries.effect: Small and easy to stow; takes up almost no space.

entries.name: Complete
entries.effect: Whole and unbroken; nothing missing, every piece accounted for.

entries.name: Concealable
entries.effect: Can be hidden on your person or in a bag without notice.

entries.name: Conspicuous
entries.effect: Impossible to ignore; people remember seeing it, and seeing you with it.

entries.name: Container
entries.effect: Contains stuff it could reasonably be expected to hold; size matters.

entries.name: Contraband
entries.effect: Banned or restricted goods; valuable on the right market, risky to move.

entries.name: Corrosive
entries.effect: Eats through material on contact; ruins gear, restraints, locks, flesh, and evidence alike.

entries.name: Counterfeit
entries.effect: A convincing fake; passes casual inspection but fails an expert's eye.

entries.name: Cramped
entries.effect: Too tight for comfort or a proper fight; hard to maneuver inside.

entries.name: Cursed
entries.effect: Carries misfortune for its owner; getting rid of it is harder than it should be.

entries.name: Defensible
entries.effect: Easy to hold against intruders; clear sightlines and chokepoints.

entries.name: Derelict
entries.effect: Falling apart and easy to overlook, but nobody comes to investigate most of the time.

entries.name: Devastating
entries.effect: Leaves savage wounds; any Harm it inflicts cannot be healed by any means short of a day's rest.

entries.name: Disguised
entries.effect: Lets the wearer pass as someone or something they're not; holds up until someone looks too closely.

entries.name: Disposable
entries.effect: Cheap and replaceable; easy to ditch and to source another.

entries.name: Encrypted
entries.effect: Locked behind strong cryptic protection; useless to anyone without the key, code, or skill to crack it.

entries.name: Explosive-X
entries.effect: Detonates, dealing Aggravated Harm to everything within the stated Range (e.g., **Explosive-Close**).

entries.name: Exposed
entries.effect: Open to approach and observation from multiple angles; hard to defend.

entries.name: Flammable
entries.effect: Catches fire easily and burns fast; keep it away from sparks and other items with the same Tag.

entries.name: Forged
entries.effect: Falsified documents or credentials; opens doors until someone dutifully triple-checks.

entries.name: Fortified
entries.effect: Built to withstand assault; forcing entry takes time, tools, and noise.

entries.name: Fractured
entries.effect: Broken or incomplete; missing pieces limit what it can do until it's made whole.

entries.name: Fragile
entries.effect: Breaks easily; rough use or a bad hit can put it out of commission.

entries.name: Freezing
entries.effect: Bitterly cold; disables Movement of all kinds until something is done about the frost.

entries.name: Garlicky
entries.effect: Reeks of or contains garlic; harms anything vulnerable to it.

entries.name: Gruesome
entries.effect: Viscerally awful to behold; average people who witness its use recoil, flee, or freeze.

entries.name: Haunted
entries.effect: A Ghost or Spirit is attached to it and comes along wherever it goes; every Fetter has this Tag by default.

entries.name: Hawthorn
entries.effect: Made of or incorporating hawthorn wood; deals Aggravated Harm to anything vulnerable to it.

entries.name: Healing
entries.effect: Restores Superficial Harm when used; the amount depends on the item and the fiction.

entries.name: Hefty
entries.effect: Heavy enough to be a burden; tiring to carry or wield for long, but it hits hard.

entries.name: Hidden
entries.effect: Hard to find without being told where to look.

entries.name: Holy
entries.effect: Repels and/or deals Aggravated Harm to anything vulnerable to religious symbols or blessings.

entries.name: Ignore-Armor
entries.effect: Bypasses Armor entirely; the target marks full Harm regardless of protection.

entries.name: Ignore-BP-Armor
entries.effect: Bypasses an amount of Armor equal to the wielder's Blood Potency.

entries.name: Illegal
entries.effect: Possessing it is a crime; getting caught with it brings the law down on you (mortal or otherwise).

entries.name: Improvised
entries.effect: Quickly grabbed and used as a tool for a job not suited to its original purpose (like using a chair as a club).

entries.name: Incendiary
entries.effect: Deals Aggravated Harm and sets things alight; fire spreads if left unchecked.

entries.name: Incriminating
entries.effect: Proof of someone's wrongdoing; dangerous to hold, valuable as leverage.

entries.name: Infernal
entries.effect: A small piece of the Outer Dark given form and function; grants its bearer some terrible "benefit" and attracts demonic attention wherever it goes.

entries.name: Intoxicating
entries.effect: Impairs whoever consumes it; alters senses & perception, even secondhand through blood.

entries.name: Jury-Rigged
entries.effect: Held together with improvisation and hope; works now, no promises about later.

entries.name: Lightweight
entries.effect: Barely there; quick to carry, draw, or wear all night.

entries.name: Lubricating
entries.effect: Slick and slippery; greases machinery, restraints, footing, or bodies (scent optional).

entries.name: Luminous
entries.effect: Sheds bright light; banishes darkness and dazzles eyes adjusted to the dark.

entries.name: Magical
entries.effect: Carries a supernatural effect; works on things mundane tools can't touch.

entries.name: Marked
entries.effect: Bears the colors, logo, or insignia of an allegiance; friends and enemies both read it at a glance.

entries.name: Messy
entries.effect: Leaves clear evidence of its use splattered everywhere.

entries.name: Modular
entries.effect: Breaks down, reconfigures, or accepts attachments; spend a scene modifying it to swap one other Tag for a different one (within reason).

entries.name: N-Armor
entries.effect: Reduces incoming Superficial Harm by a flat amount until removed or destroyed.

entries.name: N-Charge
entries.effect: Holds a number of charges of a renewable resource; powered or magical.

entries.name: N-Fireproof
entries.effect: Works like Armor against fire, removing a number of points of Aggravated Harm from flame; the item itself won't catch alight.

entries.name: N-Harm
entries.effect: Deals an amount of Harm when it hits; the foundation of any weapon.

entries.name: N-Use
entries.effect: Works a set number of times, then it's spent until restocked, reloaded, or replaced; mundane or non-renewable.

entries.name: Networked
entries.effect: Connected, powered, and online; full utilities and network access.

entries.name: Nimble
entries.effect: Corners and weaves with ease; built for tight spaces, cool stunts, and quick escapes.

entries.name: Nitro-Boosted
entries.effect: A burst of overwhelming speed on demand; thrilling but hard on the engine; usable once per scene.

entries.name: Noisy
entries.effect: Draws attention from anyone within Far Range curious about the sounds.

entries.name: Off-Road
entries.effect: Handles terrain that stops ordinary vehicles; mud, rubble, wilderness, stairs.

entries.name: Official
entries.effect: Carries genuine authority; credentials, uniforms, or seals that command deference and compliance.

entries.name: Ornate
entries.effect: Beautiful and clearly valuable; attracts notice and covetous eyes.

entries.name: Outdated
entries.effect: Behind the times; works, but incompatible, unsupported, or easy to outmaneuver.

entries.name: Perishable
entries.effect: Spoils if not used fresh; time, heat, and neglect render it worthless.

entries.name: Piercing
entries.effect: Ideal for staking.

entries.name: Pocketed
entries.effect: Riddled with hidden pockets; carries far more than it looks like it should.

entries.name: Poisonous
entries.effect: Sickens or inflicts Harm upon the living that ingest it; the dead are mostly unaffected.

entries.name: Prestigious
entries.effect: A mark of status; impresses those who recognize what it signals.

entries.name: Putrid
entries.effect: Foul enough to turn stomachs; anyone too close risks gagging, vomiting, or worse.

entries.name: Radioactive
entries.effect: Leaks invisible contamination; lingers in an area and sickens the living over time.

entries.name: Recharge-X
entries.effect: Refills its charge(s) under the stated condition (e.g., **Recharge-Dawn**, **Recharge-Scene**).

entries.name: Reflective
entries.effect: Shows clear reflections; reveals at a glance who has one and who doesn't.

entries.name: Refrigerated
entries.effect: Chilled storage; contents stay fresh far longer than they otherwise would (especially anything **Perishable**).

entries.name: Registered
entries.effect: Legally on the books in your name; legitimate, but it's in a database somewhere.

entries.name: Reinforced
entries.effect: Built tougher than standard; resists ramming, breaching, and structural damage.

entries.name: Relic
entries.effect: An object of great historical or spiritual weight; certain people will kill to possess it.

entries.name: Restraining
entries.effect: Binds and holds a captive; escaping takes help, leverage, luck, or a great deal of effort.

entries.name: Returning
entries.effect: Comes back to your hand after being thrown or knocked away.

entries.name: Salted
entries.effect: Coated, lined, or filled with dry salt; an unbroken line of it stops certain creatures in their tracks.

entries.name: Sedating
entries.effect: Induces unconsciousness or stupor in the living; the dead are much harder to put down.

entries.name: Self-Replicating
entries.effect: Makes more of itself given time and opportunity; contain it or it spreads.

entries.name: Sentient
entries.effect: Aware, conscious, and willful; has its own desires and can communicate somehow.

entries.name: Shabby
entries.effect: Worn, cheap, and forgettable; marks its owner as someone not worth a second glance.

entries.name: Shielded
entries.effect: Blocks signals, scans, electrical surges, and/or detection; nothing gets in or out electronically.

entries.name: Silver
entries.effect: Deals Aggravated Harm to anything vulnerable to silver.

entries.name: Single-Exit
entries.effect: Only one way in or out; easy to guard, easy to get cornered in.

entries.name: Slow-Reload
entries.effect: Takes a while to ready again; you can't reload or recharge it until combat is over.

entries.name: Sluggish
entries.effect: Slow to accelerate and turn; gets where it's going eventually but is more likely to be caught.

entries.name: Smart
entries.effect: Automated and responsive; clever enough to follow commands, learn habits, and act on its own.

entries.name: Soothing
entries.effect: Calms nerves and quiets the Beast; eases fear and frayed composure rather than wounds.

entries.name: Soundproof
entries.effect: No sound escapes or enters; what happens inside stays inside.

entries.name: Spacious
entries.effect: Room enough for the whole Coterie and then some.

entries.name: Speedy
entries.effect: Outpaces most things on the road; built for getting somewhere or getting gone.

entries.name: Sticky
entries.effect: Clings and adheres; traps, slows, or holds fast whatever it touches.

entries.name: Stinky
entries.effect: Reeks badly enough to foul the air and ruin anything tracking by scent.

entries.name: Stolen
entries.effect: Someone wants it back, and they may be looking; hard to sell or display openly.

entries.name: Sturdy
entries.effect: Takes a beating and keeps working; resists wear, weather, and abuse.

entries.name: Stylish
entries.effect: Striking and fashionable; turns heads and opens doors that stay shut to the drab.

entries.name: Subterranean
entries.effect: Below ground; naturally climate-controlled, low-light, and insulated from the world above.

entries.name: Subtle
entries.effect: Doesn't read as a weapon or a threat; draws no attention when carried.

entries.name: Sunproof
entries.effect: No sunlight reaches the interior; safe to slumber through the day.

entries.name: Suppressed
entries.effect: Fitted with a suppressor/silencer or other sound-dampening device. Audible only within Close Range regardless of its usual noisiness.

entries.name: Surveilled
entries.effect: Watched by cameras, sensors, or eyes; assume all comings and goings are recorded and reviewed.

entries.name: Tantalizing
entries.effect: Smells temptingly of fresh blood; hungry Kindred struggle to ignore it.

entries.name: Trapped
entries.effect: Rigged to harm or catch intruders who don't know the trick.

entries.name: [Trespasser]-Warded
entries.effect: Protected by a (***Lesser*** or ***Greater***) Ward keyed to a named Trespasser type (e.g., **Ghoul-Warded**); triggers when that type of entity touches it.

entries.name: Two-Handed
entries.effect: Requires both hands; no shield, no free grip, no phone.

entries.name: Unbreakable
entries.effect: Cannot be broken, shattered, or destroyed by ordinary means.

entries.name: Unreliable
entries.effect: Works inconsistently; the Storyteller can have it jam, stall, or sputter at a dramatic moment.

entries.name: Untraceable
entries.effect: Leaves no trail; no records, no registration, no way to follow it home.

entries.name: UV
entries.effect: Emits concentrated ultraviolet light; deals Aggravated Harm to anything vulnerable to UV.

entries.name: Verified
entries.effect: Confirmed true and reliable; the rare piece of information you can actually trust.

entries.name: Watchful
entries.effect: Watches, listens, or records; cameras, bugs, trackers, drones, hidden eyes, government birds.

entries.name: Weatherproof
entries.effect: Shrugs off rain, cold, wind, and the elements; keeps the wearer and its contents dry.

entries.name: Welcoming
entries.effect: Mortals can be invited in and put at ease; often ideal for **Feeding**.

entries.name: Wrought-Iron
entries.effect: Forged from true wrought iron, the old stuff; deals Aggravated Harm to anything vulnerable to it.
